problem.title: Convert a Binary Search Tree into a Circular Doubly Linked List
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree, convert it into a sorted circular doubly linked list by modifying only the existing node pointers.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the BST.
problem.output: • Print the circular doubly linked list starting from its smallest element.
